commands.name: device_info
commands.notes: Used to identify model and firmware. Physical TA612C returned model 612 and firmware 3.50.

commands.name: live_data
commands.notes: Returns one four-channel live-data frame per request in the documented/request-response model.

commands.name: rec_download
commands.notes: Downloads internally recorded REC data. Multiple response frames may follow one request.

commands.name: time_sync
commands.notes: EnvironmentalTester 1.21/1.22 builds the payload from QDateTime::currentDateTime().toTime_t(), i.e. a 32-bit Unix timestamp, followed by checksum.

commands.name: DATA_ERASE
commands.notes: EnvironmentalTester 1.22 labels this TX path DATA_ERASE. Static analysis did not find the TA612C interface invoking it. In one explicitly authorized 2026-09-15 trial, a single bare command returned no bytes and the immediate nine-group REC readback was byte-for-byte unchanged. This does not prove safety or general non-applicability. Do not include it in normal tools or probe variants by guesswork.
